name: Block Drop
description: Block Drop is a falling-block puzzle game in the spirit of that classic genre. Pieces drop on a grid; you move and rotate them so filled lines clear, the score climbs, and later pieces fall faster. The game itself is a static page of HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript — no framework, bundler, or build step. A small high-scores API sits behind it so scores can be recorded across visits. It is a private toy app I run on my own domain.

name: DressMe
description: DressMe is a personal wardrobe catalog aimed at classic menswear. You capture items with photos and attributes, browse what you own, and ask for outfit ideas for a given occasion. Suggestions come back as three looks drawn only from your catalog, shown as flat-lay collages of your actual pieces. The app is private and sign-in gated so the wardrobe stays yours. Catalog first; outfit suggestions follow from what you have logged.

name: Netrunner
description: Netrunner is a Classic Netrunner card catalog. Browse the full set, generate random Runner and Corp starters, or open Limited, Proteus, and Classic boosters. The site is static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — a cards-only rebuild of an earlier Play Framework / Scala version from 2017. There is no account system and no deck-builder backend; it is meant for browsing and random draws. Duplicate cards are allowed in random packs, same as the original app.
